title: Teams Lock in Mission Architecture for NASA’s SR-1 Freedom
description: NASA completed a major review for Space Reactor-1 (SR-1) Freedom and locked in key elements of the spacecraft, which is targeted to launch in 2028 and demonstrate nuclear electric propulsion in deep space for the first time.   Experts from across the agency, the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), and industry met at NASA’s Glenn Research […]
